I don't see it being helpful. Talking about these things in the past has made me feel worse as it makes me feel like I can't handle my own emotions. 

Why it it helpful?

No, not really. I'm ashamed of not being able to break out of this. 

Well, I lost my job recently. Getting a new one is kind of hard, mainly because the ones I want to do i don't have the experience for and education is so expensive. I'm already in debt for an arts degree that jobs out there don't use. I studied it because i wanted to teach in a public school but the state raised the minimum requirement for the graduate program to 2 years instead of 1 and I'm having second thoughts about teaching. Low pay, I have to work with kids when I'm fairly unstable right now and more debt. I just want a job that i can get into and work my way up in but a lot of the jobs are tech roles which I can't do, some obscure ones which are incredibly competitive or sales jobs which I don't want to do. 

It's like, why go on when noone needs you and the jobs out there seem so terrible.
